page.monthlyDetails: Monthly results, station data and CSV
page.weatherMethod: Each city supplies 8,760 hourly outdoor temperatures from the Climate.OneBuilding 2011–2025 TMYx collection. Each file joins twelve representative months, so two cities’ Januaries can come from different years. Most files draw on 15 source years. Aktau draws on 14 years within 2011–2025 and Taraz Airport on 10 within 2011–2021. Ekibastuz, Qonaev and Taldykorgan use ERA5 reanalysis, a weather reconstruction. The station details identify airport locations and link to each original weather file.
page.almatyEvidence: The former city-centre file averages 19.7 °C in its selected July 2014. The station’s daily observations average 24.9 °C. The airport file averages 24.8 °C in its selected July 2022, compared with 26.1 °C from that airport’s daily observations. In June 2024 the airport comparison is 21.2 versus 24.3 °C. A cooler file can understate cooling electricity and overstate chiller-off hours.
page.coolingMethod: The climate chart shows monthly means. Chiller-off hours count individual hours at or below the full-load threshold, so cities with similar monthly means can have different results. At the selected setpoint, the Astana plant model calculates power at each outdoor temperature. Each city supplies its own count of hours at that temperature. The totals include chiller, dry-cooler fan and loop-pump electricity. Equipment sizing also requires local extremes and equipment performance maps.
